annotations.title: Change an order or send it

description: Changes one order, named by id: its status (awaiting_customer sends it to the customer to confirm with a tap), its payment status (set by a person; a screenshot alone does not mark it paid), its payment method, its lines or delivery until it is cancelled or returned (an order sent or confirmed is then a draft again for the customer to confirm; one out for delivery or delivered only by an owner or an admin), its notes, or a cancel reason. Each call needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it changes the order. Returns the order.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

courier.description: Who delivers it. Set at any time, like the arrival day.

delivery_date.description: The arrival day. The day before it the customer is told "Out for delivery tomorrow".

tracking_number.description: The courier’s tracking number. Set at any time, like the arrival day.

id.description: The order, by its ord_ id.

name.description: A custom item’s name. A product’s is the list’s.

product_id.description: A product of the chat’s number. Left out or null: a custom item.

unit_price.description: A custom item’s price, typed by the seller. A product of the list is priced by the list.

payment_status.description: Set by the seller. A payment screenshot alone does not mark it paid.

status.description: awaiting_customer sends the order to the customer for their Confirm tap (Starter and up). The other statuses are recorded as they are set.
